categories.main_business_segments: Dexcom is a medical device company primarily focused on the design, development, and commercialization of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems for diabetes management. The company's main products include the Dexcom G6 and G7 CGM systems, Dexcom ONE, Dexcom Stelo (in development for Type 2 diabetes), and related software platforms like Dexcom Clarity and Dexcom Share. The company also offers data and insulin delivery collaborations and a Real-Time API for third-party integration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Dexcom's core technology platform is based on proprietary sensor technology utilizing biomaterials, membrane systems, electrochemistry, and low-power microelectronics. The company manufactures wire-based sensors internally and assembles products with externally sourced components. Key manufacturing facilities are located in San Diego (California), Mesa (Arizona), and Penang (Malaysia), with planned expansion in Ireland. The company uses a highly controlled manufacturing environment to minimize contaminants and ensure quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Dexcom's primary customers are people with Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes who use insulin therapy, as well as non-insulin users with hypoglycemia risk. The company is expanding into broader Type 2 diabetes populations and exploring markets including pregnant women, people with pre-diabetes, and hospital settings. Key end markets include endocrinologists, physicians, diabetes educators, and healthcare systems globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: Dexcom operates primarily in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America, Africa, and the Middle East. As of December 31, 2023, international operations accounted for approximately 28% of revenue. The company has significant presence in the United States, European Union, and is expanding in Asia through its new Malaysia manufacturing facility and planned Ireland facility.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dexcom operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the diabetes care supply chain. The company manufactures CGM devices and related products, then distributes them through direct sales organizations, distributors, and pharmacy partnerships to end-users (patients) and healthcare providers. The company also relies on upstream suppliers for components and materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Dexcom's strategic priorities include establishing its technology platform as the leading CGM approach, supporting innovation through technology integration partnerships with insulin delivery companies, pursuing broad coverage and reimbursement policies, expanding to other patient demographics and care settings, and developing next-generation products with improved performance and convenience. The company is also investing in cloud-based data platforms and predictive analytics using machine learning.
categories.revenue_model: Dexcom generates revenue primarily through product sales of CGM systems, including recurring sales of disposable sensors. The company also generates revenue through cloud-based software services (Dexcom Clarity), remote monitoring systems (Dexcom Share), and licensing arrangements. Revenue is dependent on third-party payor reimbursement from Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance plans.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dexcom competes directly with Abbott Laboratories (Freestyle Libre family), Medtronic (Guardian Connect and Simplera), Roche Diabetes Care, LifeScan, and Ascensia Diabetes Care. The company positions itself as a technology leader with superior accuracy (G7 has 8.2% MARD), integrated ecosystem connectivity, and clinical evidence of improved outcomes. Dexcom faces competition from both traditional medical device companies and newer entrants in the population health space.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of June 30, 2023, Dexcom had an aggregate market value of approximately $49.4 billion based on a stock price of $128.51 per share. The company is classified as a large accelerated filer by the SEC. As of December 31, 2023, Dexcom had approximately 9,600 employees globally. The company has experienced significant growth and is expanding manufacturing capacity substantially to meet anticipated market demand.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dexcom's value proposition centers on continuous glucose monitoring that eliminates finger sticks, provides real-time glucose readings and trend information, enables predictive alerts, integrates with wearables and insulin delivery systems, and has demonstrated clinical benefits in reducing A1C levels and improving time in range. The G7 is positioned as the most accurate FDA-cleared CGM with a 30-minute warm-up time and all-in-one wearable design that is 60% smaller than the G6, offering superior convenience and discretion compared to competitors.
